summary: Verified scroll-to-top navigation bug fix in Layout.jsx (useEffect on [pathname, hash, navType], skips POP and hash). Ran full Playwright suite on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). All PRIMARY, SECONDARY, ALL-CITY-PAGES, BROWSER-BACK, HASH-ANCHOR, and MOBILE flows pass. All regression checks (Yorba Linda H1 'Drive In Today', hero 'not located in Yorba Linda', address '144 S Bradford Ave, Placentia, CA 92870', 5 FAQ items, all 6 nav links, AutomotiveBusiness sameAs Google Business Profile URL, homepage 'Fast, honest smog checks in Placentia.' copy, mascot mix-blend-mode 'screen') pass.

issues: H1 getBoundingClientRect().top is 222px after nav (spec asked <200px). scrollY IS 0 and H1 is fully visible in viewport; the offset comes from sticky nav (~90px) + hero pill 'SERVING YORBA LINDA DRIVERS SINCE 1999' rendered above the H1. Not a functional bug - just tighter than the spec's <200 proxy. Can be resolved either by relaxing the check or reducing hero top padding.

critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx fix is correct and minimal. useNavigationType() + hash check + resetting window.scrollTo(0,0), documentElement.scrollTop, body.scrollTop covers iOS Safari edge cases.

Note: Playwright's page.click() uses smooth scroll-into-view before clicking during tests; this can make scrollY briefly non-zero (~1s animation) before the effect's scrollTo(0,0) settles. Real user taps do not exhibit this. Verified by polling scrollY until stable in tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The scroll-to-top fix in Layout.jsx works across all routes and both viewports. Browser Back preserves scroll (2214px preserved on home after goBack). Hash anchor click on LocationCallout scrolls #finding-us section to top of viewport (top=-0.17) without our reset interfering. If retesting, note that Playwright's built-in smooth scroll-into-view can transiently show non-zero scrollY immediately after click; poll until settled or use JS .click() to avoid it.
rca of the issue: Original bug: no scroll reset on SPA route change caused new pages to open at previous scroll offset. Fix: added useEffect keyed on [pathname, hash, navType] resetting window.scrollTo(0,0) + documentElement/body scrollTop; guards for POP (preserve browser scroll restoration) and hash (preserve in-page anchor scroll). Verified fix works on all 6 route transitions in desktop and mobile; Back and Hash flows are correctly excluded.
